header.title: Hi, I'm Kamila
header.description: Graphic designer. I love creating original things.

about.title: About
about.description: At the end of 2023, I began my studies in Computer Graphics and Multimedia Production at [University of Information Technology and Management](https://wsiz.edu.pl/). I had already been passionate about painting, both traditional and digital. My skills began to develop at a rapid pace, and today I am an experienced graphic designer with a focus on marketing.

projects.title: Check out my latest work
projects.description: I've worked on a variety of projects, from simple mockups to complex layouts. Here are a few of my favorites.

vasabi.title: Vasabi Restaurant Menu
vasabi.description: Vasabi restaurant menu design combines **modern minimalism** with **traditional Japanese aesthetics**. The goal was to create a visual identity that feels both **elegant and authentic**, reflecting the fusion of Japanese and Asian cuisine.

core-motion-physiotherapy.title: Core Motion Physiotherapy Brochure
core-motion-physiotherapy.description: The **Core Motion Physiotherapy** brochure was designed to communicate the clinic’s mission of _“Pain-Free Living”_ while providing essential information about their physiotherapy services in a clear and approachable way. The tri-fold format ensures a professional and practical layout, perfect for distribution in clinics, community centers, and wellness events.
